newsitem.title: USA: Gilead to increase sales force for Vistide.
newsitem.headline: Gilead to increase sales force for Vistide.

text.p: Gilead Sciences Inc said on Monday that it will increase its sales force to 26 from 19 by the end of December of this year.

Gilead vice president for corporate development Jeffrey Bird said at a conference in New York that the new representatives will primarily sell Vistide, the company's drug used to treat blindness in AIDS patients.
Bird said the increased sales force will allow the company to cover 80 percent of its target customer base. He said the company is currently covering 65 percent of that base.
The sales force will operate in the U.S. only, he added.
Gilead declined to comment on how much it plans to spend to increase its sales force.
